$Comment: The stacked bar panel in the left column: the running ledger of whatever a player is in the
middle of. A row appears the moment a mod reports a value moved and goes away when it stops;
nothing is authored for one to show up. Server/ZiggfreedCommon/HudBars/ is where you retune a
single row, and this file is the panel they all sit on.
Placement names the spot the panel sits at, one of the files under
Server/ZiggfreedCommon/HudBarPlacements/ (TopLeft is shipped for this panel). That file carries
the corner, the offsets and how the rows spread there. To nudge it without changing the spot,
add a Position block here with only the leaves you want different, or a Columns or
RowsPerColumn leaf; anything you leave out keeps the spot's own value. A player may pick
another offered spot for themselves in the HUD settings, and their pick replaces the whole
group.
MaxVisible is unstated, so every slot the panel has is available; state a smaller number to
keep it short, and the most recently moved rows are the ones you see. RepaintMs is how often
the panel redraws at most: a movement redraws immediately when the last redraw is already that
old, and one arriving sooner is drawn at the window's end, so a number on screen is never left
waiting on a later movement to bring it up to date. Lower is livelier and costs more network
traffic. LabelKey names the panel in the HUD settings.
To change a leaf without copying this file, add an entry keyed 'Default' to
mods/ziggfreedcommon/hud-bar-panels.json with only the leaves you want different, or use the
Server tab of the HUD settings, which writes that file for you. Set Enabled to false there to
switch this whole panel off for everyone.
